description:
Qiqi ( Chinese : 七七 Qīqī ) is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

Resurrected as a zombie by the adepti , she has ended up in Baizhu 's care and now works at Bubu Pharmacy in Liyue Harbor .

According to Zibai, Qiqi had her Three Deadly Selves severed, but unlike a complete process, only one damaged and incomplete self remains in her body. This fragment was likely shattered and later reassembled through adeptal magic, while the others are lost. The sigil on her forehead stabilizes what’s left of her soul, keeping her alive but leaving her with severe memory issues due to her incomplete state.
role_summary: Qiqi ( Chinese : 七七 Qīqī ) is a playable Cryo character in Genshin Impact .

talents.name: Ancient Sword Art
talents.description: Normal Attack Performs up to 5 rapid strikes. Charged Attack Consumes a certain amount Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes. Plunging Attack Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

talents.name: Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost
talents.description: Using the Icevein Talisman, Qiqi brings forth the Herald of Frost, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents. Herald of Frost On hit, Qiqi's Normal and Charged Attacks regenerate HP for your own party members and nearby teammates. Healing scales based on Qiqi's ATK. Periodically regenerates your active character's HP. Follows the character around, dealing Cryo DMG to opponents in their path.

talents.name: Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune
talents.description: Qiqi releases the adeptus power sealed within her body, marking nearby opponents with a Fortune-Preserving Talisman that deals Cryo DMG . Fortune-Preserving Talisman When opponents affected by this Talisman take DMG, the character that dealt this DMG regenerates HP.

talents.name: Life-Prolonging Methods
talents.description: When a character under the effects of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost triggers an Elemental Reaction , their Incoming Healing Bonus is increased by 20% for 8s.

talents.name: A Glimpse Into Arcanum
talents.description: When Qiqi hits opponents with her Normal and Charged Attacks , she has a 50% chance to apply a Fortune-Preserving Talisman to them for 6s. This effect can only occur once every 30s.

talents.name: Former Life Memories
talents.description: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Liyue on the mini-map .

c1.name: Ascetics of Frost
c1.effect: When the Herald of Frost hits an opponent marked by a Fortune-Preserving Talisman, Qiqi regenerates 2 Energy.

c2.name: Frozen to the Bone
c2.effect: Qiqi's Normal and Charge Attack DMG against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

c3.name: Ascendant Praise
c3.effect: Increases the Level of Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Divine Suppression
c4.effect: Targets marked by the Fortune-Preserving Talisman have their ATK decreased by 20%.

c5.name: Crimson Lotus Bloom
c5.effect: Increases the Level of Adeptus Art: Herald of Frost by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Rite of Resurrection
c6.effect: Using Adeptus Art: Preserver of Fortune revives all fallen party members nearby and regenerates 50% of their HP. This effect can only occur once every 15 mins.
